data.title: 在原七海 · 被炉旁的橘子与夜谈
data.description: 冬夜客厅里开着暖融融的被炉，七海把猫耳兜帽松松垂在背后，双肘支在矮桌边缘慢条斯理地剥着一只金黄蜜橘。珊瑚绒袖口软绵绵地裹到手腕，她递过半瓣橘子时眼角弯起，全然卸下了平日特工般的机警。
data.location: 暖光点亮的冬夜起居室被炉桌旁
data.action: 趴在被炉桌边剥蜜橘，含笑递向对面
data.lighting: 客厅暖黄吸顶灯与窗外静谧深蓝夜色呼应
data.camera: 斜对角中近景，蜜橘篮与热茶杯入镜
data.mood: 软糯、居家、充满兄妹般的依赖感
data.promptProse: Leaning her elbows on the warm kotatsu table in the softly lit living room, Nanami peels a bright tangerine while her plush pastel-pink fleece sleeves cuff comfortably around her wrists. She holds out a fresh slice across the low table with a relaxed, affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Resting her elbows on the kotatsu table, she peels a tangerine and offers a segment with a warm smile.
